nodes.name: Telegram Trigger
nodes.notes: T14.3: Customer bot only (alpsteinai_0001bot). Trigger On: message. MVP filtering in Normalize.

nodes.name: Normalize Telegram Incoming
nodes.notes: T14.3: Drops bot/non-text/group/channel/edited. business_id default alpstein_ai_demo_001.

string.name: operator_business_context
string.value:
Alpstein AI demo business.
We help businesses with AI assistants, CRM integrations, workflow automation, Telegram AI assistants, and customer communication systems.
Reply in the customer's language (German, English, Russian, and other supported languages).
Tone: calm, clear, concise, helpful.
Do not ask for the customer's name unless they clearly need identification or want to book.

nodes.name: Add Business Context
nodes.notes: T14-OC-3: Alpstein AI operator facts only. No barbershop domain.

nodes.name: POST Backend
nodes.notes: T14.3+OC-3: POST includes operator_business_context. Excludes telegram_chat_id.

nodes.name: Shape Telegram Customer Reply
nodes.notes: T14.3: reply_to_customer only — no backend envelope to Telegram.

nodes.name: Telegram Send Message
nodes.notes: T14.3: Customer bot + chat_id from normalize. Not TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.

nodes.name: IF Notify Owner
nodes.notes: T14.3 optional: T13.5 pattern; reads POST Backend only.

nodes.name: Telegram Owner Notify
nodes.notes: Owner bot only. TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID env — not customer chat.

parameters.content:
## Telegram customer ingress (Alpstein AI)

Trigger → Normalize → Add Business Context → POST Backend → Shape → Send.

business_id: alpstein_ai_demo_001. Owner notify parallel from POST Backend.
